items: A pickup truck is the standard for shore diving: tanks ride in the bed (ask for a tank rack).

Rates found (Oct 2026): Carib Inn guest truck $490/week (guests only) · Budget Toyota Hilux $62/day (Oct 15–Nov 12) and $59/day (Nov 13–Dec 15), including $17/day CDW · Bonaire Truck Rental from $53/day including CDW, free 2nd driver and a tank rack.
Drive on the right; distances are in km. Watch for donkeys and goats. The northern coastal road narrows and is one-way north of Karpata (return via Rincon).
A 2WD pickup is fine for the south/central sites; high clearance helps for Karpata pull-offs and Washington Slagbaai.
Taxis: few and not metered; agree the fare first or book ahead (e.g. bonaire-taxi.com, Google 4.9 (38)).
Gas: government-set price. Gasoline $1.64/L, diesel $1.32/L (from Aug 28, 2026).
Not bringing an EV, so no adapter needed.
For reference: public charging is scarce. Three Type 2 (22 kW AC) sites: Chogogo/Isidel Beach Park (north of town) and Openbaar Ministerie downtown. No Tesla network, no DC fast charging.
Currency is the US dollar; cards are widely accepted. Keep small bills for tips, fruit stands and small local spots (Maiky Snack prefers cash).
Visitor Entry Tax: card only.
eSIM: Digicel tourist eSIM ~$30 for 7 days/7 GB or ~$50 for 14 days/20 GB (per Digicel pages via search). Flow also sells an eSIM. Or check your US carrier's roaming plan.
Warm year-round, highs typically ~85–89°F. Sea ~83°F in Oct.
Rainy season is Oct–Jan, with November the wettest. Showers are usually short, often at night or early morning.
Hurricane season ends Nov 30. Bonaire sits outside the main belt.
American: Miami (MIA) to Bonaire.
Delta: Atlanta (ATL) on Saturdays.
United: Houston (IAH) on Saturdays/Sundays; Newark (EWR) from about Oct 31.
Wi-Fi: Starlink only possibly on United; don't count on it.
Our flights: TBD.

items: Truck break-ins at dive sites are the #1 complaint. Leave nothing in the truck; many divers leave windows down and the cab empty.
Marine hazards: fire coral and urchins at entries, lionfish spines (don't touch), boat traffic near piers (use a dive flag/SMB), current at Karpata/Red Slave.
Salt Pier is closed when a ship is docked.
Last dive at least 24 h before flying.
Hospital + recompression chamber: Fundashon Mariadal, Kralendijk · +599 715 8900
Police: 911
Ambulance: 912 (sources differ between 911 and 912; confirm at orientation)

See Deals & Activities for prices and ratings: sunset sails, Klein Bonaire, mangrove kayak, night bioluminescence snorkel, windsurf at Lac Bay, Washington Slagbaai, caves, land sailing, horses, Donkey Sanctuary.
Free: flamingo spotting at the salt pans, Lac Bay/Sorobon beach, the slave huts and salt pyramids in the south, sunset on the Kralendijk boulevard.
Bonaire Regatta: Oct 11–17, 2026 (races Oct 12–16, closing Boat Party Oct 17). Town is busy; extra water checks.
Sinterklaas (Sanikolas) arrival: expected Sat Nov 28, 2026, ~3 PM at the Kralendijk harbor (not yet officially confirmed).
